title: Resident Evil 6 (PS3, BLUS30855, RPCS3)
notes: SCAFFOLD (request 3275, 2026-10-26): PS3 BLUS30855 RAM map scaffold. Step 1 verified launch on Spark (session 2198666ea8194539-fc8bef25d3bd47bd, worker lilspark, RPCS3 v0.0.43-20355-4024ea31).
HOST RULE: live RE6 sessions go on i9-NUC (ec678a28567942b3), never Spark (operator MercMode rotation) and never JAYBUILTFINALE.

This map is a structural scaffold: field names and types are declared from the MT Framework pattern (same engine as RE5 PS3) and the Xbox 360 partial map (docs/re6-ram-map-0871eee3b68cdea3.json), but PS3 offsets are NOT yet measured live.
All pointer fields carry evidence 'pending-live-measurement' and must be verified on a live i9-NUC RPCS3 session before the observer is marked ready.
Do not mark mercs.ready=true until every required vocab name is mapped to a verified live address.
